messages:
leila: Noticed repeated p99 spikes on some hosts after tenants spill to warm-pool. traces show PCIe stalls + NIC queueing. happened in eu-west-1b around 22:10.

omar: Interesting. Could be cross-host KV fetches + PCIe transfer bursts. do we have per-slice PCIe/host-egress signals?

chen: We log host.pcie_util and host.nic_queue_depth but not per-slice. fractional dedicated tenants can generate many small DMA ops that thrash the bus. Sample:
```
[2026-10-05T22:10:12Z] host=eu-west-1b-081 pcie_util=78% nic_q=42 tx_retries=34 preempt=tenant=chatty-svc
```

leila: Proposal: adaptive spillback throttle. When host.pcie_util>70% and nic_q>30, throttle warm-pool spillbacks for slices whose recent KV miss_rate > 0.5. Instead of full spill, route to local quantized replica or queue with jitter.

omar: We should also add a per-host cap on concurrent spillbacks to avoid synchronized waves. Maybe a token bucket that refills slowly when pcie_util high.

chen: Quick cost note: local quantized runs cost ~15% more CPU but saves cross-host retransmits. simulate with last week's traces to get expected bytes avoided.

leila: Rollout: feature-flag in eu-west-1b, canary 6 hosts for 3h, monitors: host.pcie_util, host.nic_q, tx_retries, allocator.spillback_throttle_count, p99-gen-latency. Ops will alert if tenant error-rate > 1% or p99 increases.

ops-bot: experiment created by leila: adaptive-spillback-throttle v1 -> canary(eu-west-1b 6 hosts, 3h). monitors=[host.pcie_util, host.nic_q, tx_retries, allocator.spillback_throttle_count, p99-gen-latency].

omar: I'll run replay sim and post estimates. Chen, can you add a short metric spillback.queue_depth per host?

chen: On it. tagging @oncall to watch 22:00-02:00 UTC window tomorrow. :rotating_light:
